## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Vatican City, Vatican. It starts at 100 Viale Vaticano.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Enjoy a hassle-free visit to the Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel, and get the flexibility to explore your favorite areas until closing time.
>
> Explore the Vatican Museums at your own pace and discover the Vatican Courtyard, Hall of the Maps, Raphael Rooms, and more.
>
> See Michelangelo's masterpieces in the Sistine Chapel, like the Last Judgment and Creation of Adam.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €45.94. It was rated 3.8 out of 5 from 421 ratings and 164 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
